Paper Name: Optimizing an integrated hybrid energy system with hydrogen-based storage to develop an off-grid green community for sustainable development in Bangladesh
NOTES: Paper: Jaman et al. (2025) IJHE 97, 766-786. Optimal configuration: PV/WT/FC/BG. COE reported instead of LCOE. LPSP constraint was 1±0.5% but achieved LPSP value not explicitly reported. PV model SPR-E20-327 (SunPower). eta_PV reported as 20.4% in Appendix Table A but also stated as 21.4% in text (line 1086) for a different PV cell type; 20.4% from Appendix used. H2 calorific value reported as HHV = 39.4 kWh/kg; H2_LHV not stated. Electrolyzer efficiency not reported as a percentage. Replacement costs listed as 'Restoration value' in Appendix; values: PV=0, WT=0, BG=1280 $/kW, FC=2500 $/kW, EL=1500 $/kW, INVT=300 $/kW. FC O&M = 0.02×initial expenditure (not a fixed $/unit cost). H2 tank O&M = 0.02×initial expenditure. No diesel generator in this system. Annual interest rate 'i' used in equations but value not explicitly stated. Off-grid system, no grid price. PV module area not reported. No diesel generator min power. Number of PV modules (N_PV=827) and WTs (N_WT=75) and FCs (N_FC=34) from Section 4.2.1 baseline; H2 tank count, electrolyzer count, and BG count not explicitly reported as counts. Biogas LHV = 23 MJ/m3 (reported for feedstock, not the H2_LHV column). Carbon penalty: $0.015/kg CO2. Diesel CO2 factor: 2.68 kg CO2/L. LCE = 123,730 kg CO2-eq/yr for PV/WT/FC/BG.
